category.description: Open project category. Known values accelerate review; a new slug enters architecture review instead of being rejected by an enum.

chainId.description: Positive JavaScript-safe EVM chain id. Application eligibility is independent from current Programmable launch-chain integration.

network.description: Canonical lowercase network slug. Known chain ids must use the standard's exact mapping; an unknown chain enters architecture review.

officialLaunchProfileId.description: Exact profile id from the committed official launchpad deployment reference. Required for the safer official-launchpad no-hook route and null for a model-specific no-hook architecture.

decimals.description: Exact base-unit decimals. Native ETH is 18.

initialSupply.description: Integer base units encoded as a string so large supplies remain exact; it must fit uint256.

used.description: True only when the canonical launch PoolKey uses a custom hook; false means the ordinary no-custom-hook launch route.

noHookArchitecture.description: Structured ordinary-token architecture used only when hook.used is false. The official launchpad remains the safer default; model-specific no-hook designs enter architecture review.

projectSurfaces.description: Open inventory of every onchain and offchain project boundary. Surface kinds are slugs rather than a closed enum; unfamiliar kinds enter architecture review.

projectCapabilities.description: Open capability inventory. Each capability declares its affected surfaces, security triggers and the profiles that those triggers require.

capabilityExtensions.description: Novel capabilities outside the current acceleration catalog. They enter architecture review and remain bound to exact source, schema and evidence paths.

tokenBehaviorExtensions.description: Open descriptions for token behaviors outside the acceleration catalog. Novel behavior is reviewable when its authority, value flow, failure, tests, provider effects and security triggers are explicit.

runtimeAssetManifestPath.description: Optional path to the closed runtime-assets v1 manifest. Large data assets declared there stay outside the strict source/test byte closure.

kind.description: Open surface kind. Known values accelerate review; an unfamiliar slug enters architecture review instead of failing schema validation.
Open capability kind. Unknown kinds remain valid but require architecture review.

requiredProfiles.description: Must equal the profiles derived from securityTriggers. Authority, source-of-truth, source-test-schema and failure-recovery are mandatory for every capability.

fundingSources.description: Every tax, allocation, protocol-revenue, donation, deposit or novel reviewed source that can fund automatic liquidity.

kind.description: Open funding-source kind. Known kinds accelerate review; a novel kind enters architecture review.
